construction: single global Boolean-quotient bounded-product subspace mask F = K*1 + v, with complete-output public-dual audit
proved_claims: Every valid Boolean witness evaluates every bounded generator multiple to zero and therefore obtains the same K from F.
On every satisfiable instance 1 is not in the public mask subspace, hence public linear algebra constructs lambda with lambda(V)=0 and lambda(1)=1, yielding lambda(F)=K without a witness.
For false instances, if 1 is in V then all key-conditioned noiseless output distributions are identical cosets; if 1 is not in V the same public dual exactly extracts K.
Every unsatisfiable CNF has 1 in the full-degree Boolean ideal span via assignment indicators, but the degree-n ambient basis has size 2^n.
For the all-exclusions family, V_D=0 below D=k and V_k is the full 2^k-dimensional Boolean function space.
With additive coefficient noise, any public annihilator obeys lambda(F)=K+lambda(e) exactly.
not_claimed: No LWE or SIS reduction for the noisy dual-functional problem.
No arbitrary-QPT early-key-recovery to source-witness reduction.
No malicious-secure ceremony or auxiliary-input composition for a surviving inner primitive.
No impossibility theorem for all noisy or nonlinear witness binders.
